title: Figures 40-41: FDL-5 scale model mockup photo and FDL-7/Model 176 escape glider drawings
description: Figure 40 is a black-and-white front-view photograph of a hypersonic glider mockup with two large strap-on tanks and landing gear; caption: "Figure 40. FDL-5 Scale Model of a Stage and One-Half Depicted." Figure 41 shows outline drawings of a delta glider with a detachable nose section separating as an escape craft; caption: "Figure 41. The FDL-7 and Model 176 Class of Hypersonic Gliders. The FDL-7 and Model 176 class of hypersonic gliders had integral, stable, controllable hypersonic-capable escape craft."
